title: IAMMAI v1 Continuity Turn Body
description: Canonical continuity turn body schema for v1. This schema defines the continuity turn as artifact only. It preserves append-oriented, artifact-linked continuity relation without carrying execution, envelope, registry, preservation, or transport context as canonical body content.

turn_id.description: Artifact identity for the continuity turn body. This is not execution or envelope identity.

matter_ref.description: Canonical reference to the bounded matter to which the continuity turn belongs.

recorded_at.description: Time at which the continuity turn body was recorded.

predecessor_turn_ref.description: Optional explicit reference to a prior continuity turn where lawful predecessor relation is part of continuity standing.

validation_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to a preserved validation artifact that helps anchor the continuity turn without replacing validation.

witness_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to a preserved witness artifact that helps anchor the continuity turn without replacing witness.

governance_action_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to a preserved governance action record that helps anchor the continuity turn without replacing governance.

transition_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to a preserved transition record that helps anchor the continuity turn without replacing transition.

state_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to a preserved state record that helps anchor the continuity turn without replacing state.
